name: Parvathy Ayyapadas
bio: Parvathy Ayyappadas is an Indian film actress, who has worked predominantly in the Malayalam movie industry(Bethlehem Kudumba Unit, Soulmates - Oru Jaathukudi Pranayam, and Super Sharanya, and Baby Girl)

credits.title: Merri Boys
credits.overview: Set around a close-knit group of young friends, the story explores modern relationships, emotional uncertainty, and the blurred lines between companionship and romance

credits.title: Ekadesham
credits.overview: In Kochi, the lives, work, and relationships of a bunch of young people overlap as they try to navigate their role in the film world.

credits.title: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
credits.overview: Ashley's homecoming from abroad takes an emotional turn when a wedding next door stirs memories of her first love, Justin.

credits.title: Baby Girl
credits.overview: On a Christmas night, a guilt-ridden hospital attendant and a determined rookie cop race against time to recover a kidnapped newborn, unaware that the woman who took the baby is fighting a heartbreaking battle to finally call a child her own.

credits.title: Super Sharanya
credits.overview: Sharanya, an ordinary small-town girl from Palakkad, who moves to Thrissur for higher studies, finds herself changing as she meets Deepu.
